title.narrative: Supplementary contribution Global Priority Gender Equality: gender equality field work and knowledge production in emerging areas

description.narrative: The supplementary contribution 43SA will support the implementation of output 8.8.GE “Global Priority Gender Equality” through : • support to up to 10 field projects whose primary objective is to promote gender equality and the empowerment of women and girls (GEM 3) in line with UNESCO’s Global Priority Gender Equality Framework across UNESCO’s mandate; and • two intersectoral GEM3 projects developed between the Division for Gender Equality and Programme Sectors including the launch the global survey on the safety of women scientists in crisis and emergency contexts and a policy brief providing a gender perspective on neurotechnology to support governments and UNESCO’s stakeholders to implement the Recommendation on the Ethics of Neurotechnology (2025) ensuring the ethical development, deployment, and use of neurotechnology.
